issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: In class GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit the template defines a method named build_grover(self, qc, query_register) but the template's run() helper calls self.grover_circuit(self.qc, self.query_register). The reference solution implements grover_circuit(self, qc, query_register). This mismatch in method names (build_grover vs grover_circuit) will cause an AttributeError/NameError when students use the provided run() scaffold and prevents the template from executing as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) with the same signature (self, qc, query_register) so the template's run() call and the solution match the scaffold and problem text. Alternatively, change the run() helper in the template to call build_grover(...). Prefer renaming build_grover to grover_circuit to match the solution and the exercise description for clarity.

issues.description: Concept: the function that assembles the one-iteration Grover circuit. Problem statement/task refers to assembling a "Grover circuit" (exercise text and task name). In the template (ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py) the assembly stub is declared as build_grover(...), but the template's run() invokes self.grover_circuit(...). The reference solution implements the assembly method as grover_circuit(...). This inconsistency (template: build_grover vs. run() and solution: grover_circuit vs. problem text referencing Grover circuit) prevents students from clearly mapping the exercise instruction to the method they must implement and may cause runtime AttributeError or confusion about which method to complete.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembly method name consistent. Rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (including its docstring and any references) so the template, problem statement task name, run() invocation, and solution all use grover_circuit. Alternatively, change the run() call to invoke build_grover, but standardizing on grover_circuit (as used in the solution and task wording) is recommended.
